metadata.name: Iterative Research
metadata.description: Iterative external research for questions that need a durable evidence record, a current report, and repeated independent critique with changed repair. Captures the question, audience, language, depth, scope, constraints, source/privacy/licensing limits, and delivery authority; writes an execution-bound contract, typed source evidence, report, review, repair account, and self-contained delivery artifact; and allows authoritative completion only after an independent reviewer reports exactly zero blocking issues. Repairs re-enter at the earliest stale contract, source, analysis, or presentation boundary, while insufficient evidence, blocked repair, and exhausted bounded review remain explicit limited outcomes. Local delivery has no external side effect; static publication and Telegram notification require separate caller authority and expose observed success or failure. Choose Verified Research for a bounded one-pass verification, Deep Corpus Research for corpus-first collection, Data Analysis for supplied datasets, Content Creation for drafting, and software-development workflows for repository changes.

nodes.directive: Own the research contract for this execution. Return execution_id exactly {{executionId}}; the next engine condition rejects any other UUID before research. Reuse every explicit caller decision and the current canonical file at ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/research-contract.md; ask only for a materially missing decision. Resolve operating_mode once: reuse an explicit value, inherit an unambiguous autonomous parent, otherwise ask once and explain that autonomous mode chooses safe local delivery at optional human gates. Write the complete current contract to that exact file: bounded research question/topic, intended audience, output language, requested depth, scope and exclusions, constraints, deliverable, source expectations, success criteria, confidentiality/privacy/licensing/minimization limits, and delivery authority. Delivery intent is local, publish, publish_and_notify, or undecided; tool availability and configuration are never authority. Do not choose another workspace or path.
nodes.completionCondition: The canonical bounded contract is current at the exact execution workspace and all typed routing inputs are resolved without broadening authority

nodes.directive: Read ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/research-contract.md and verify it agrees with the typed boundary values topic {{research_topic}}, audience {{target_audience}}, language {{output_language}}, and depth {{depth_level}} before using it. Perform only the authorized external research. Choose tools, search strategy, source mix, decomposition, and report form from the actual question and host policy; do not use fixed source counts, word counts, formatting scores, hard-coded agent names, or client-specific commands. Overwrite source-evidence.md with typed source identities and sanitized provenance, explicit acquired/unavailable/not-authorized/access-error outcomes, authority and quality judgments, recency, contradictions, uncertainty, limitations, and claim support. Never fabricate a citation, URL, author, date, access result, quotation, finding, or availability. Preserve privacy, licensing, access, and minimization limits; do not copy secrets or unnecessary sensitive bodies. Overwrite research-report.md with the current evidence-grounded answer and delivery.html with a minimized self-contained rendering containing no raw private evidence. Return sufficient only when authorized available evidence can support the contracted result; otherwise return insufficient and keep the limitations truthful in the durable files.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical source evidence, report, and delivery artifact are current, truthful, and the evidence sufficiency route matches them

nodes.directive: Act as a genuinely independent reviewer in a separate host-supported context from the research author. Read the current primary files directly: ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/research-contract.md, source-evidence.md, research-report.md, and delivery.html. Confirm execution_id is exactly {{executionId}}, the canonical workspace follows artifact_locator's immutable prefix for that ID, and the contract preserves and agrees with typed boundary values topic {{research_topic}}, audience {{target_audience}}, language {{output_language}}, and depth {{depth_level}}. Keep all candidate files immutable while reviewing. Overwrite research-review.md with the complete current set of reproducible blocking findings; zero findings is valid and at most 1000 current blocking findings may be returned. Review question fitness, source authority and quality, claim-to-source traceability, contradictions, recency, method, uncertainty, limitations, completeness for requested depth, audience and language fitness, privacy/licensing/minimization, and presentation correctness. Diagnose only; do not repair. Return only the integer count that exactly matches the written blocking findings.
nodes.completionCondition: An independent complete current review is written without candidate mutation and issues_count exactly matches it

nodes.directive: The bounded repair budget is exhausted and the latest independent review still has {{review-research.issues_count}} blocking issue(s). Explain that the result is not authoritative and cannot be published. Ask once whether to deliver the truthful limited local artifacts or abort. Do not offer reset, success, publication, or notification.
nodes.completionCondition: The user selected truthful limited local delivery or abort

nodes.directive: Read ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/research-review.md and every current primary artifact in that exact execution workspace. Reproduce all findings before changing work. The reviewer diagnoses only; you own repair. Overwrite ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/repair-account.md with what was reproduced and the exact changed artifacts, or the factual reason repair is blocked. For a changed repair, mutate the required canonical artifact now and set repair_reach only after inspecting the actual change: presentation for delivery/report presentation only, analysis for reasoning or conclusions using the current sources, sources when acquisition/provenance/source set changed, or contract when the canonical question, scope, audience, language, depth, constraints, deliverable, source/privacy/licensing limits, or delivery authority changed. Never broaden authority from a finding. If no finding can be reproduced or no artifact can be changed, return blocked with a concise cause instead of repeating unchanged work.
nodes.completionCondition: Every finding is reproduced and the canonical work changed with truthful earliest reach, or a factual blocked cause is recorded

nodes.directive: The local result has an exact zero-issue independent review. Ask once whether to keep it local, publish delivery.html through the current Moira static-artifact file/archive interface, publish and then notify through Telegram, or abort delivery. State that publication and notification are separate external side effects; neither is implied by tool availability or configuration.
nodes.completionCondition: One explicit delivery decision is recorded without performing a side effect

nodes.directive: Report the independently zero-reviewed local result to the caller. The canonical workspace is ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}} with research-contract.md, source-evidence.md, research-report.md, research-review.md, repair-account.md, and delivery.html. Do not mutate reviewed artifacts and do not publish or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: The caller receives the exact local artifact locations and no external side effect occurred

nodes.directive: Publication is explicitly authorized and the current local result has an exact zero-issue independent review. Upload only ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/delivery.html through the current Moira static-artifact file/archive interface. Do not upload research-contract.md, source-evidence.md, raw private material, credentials, or secrets. Return published only after observing the successful response and copy its real public URL exactly. On any upload/API failure return failed with the observed concise cause; do not invent a URL, notify, or rerun research.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized upload has an observed truthful success URL or an observed failure cause

nodes.message: Iterative Research completed and was published after an independent zero-issue review: {{publication_url}}

nodes.directive: Authorized available evidence is insufficient for the contracted result. Preserve truthful limitations in source-evidence.md and research-report.md, overwrite delivery.html with a clearly non-authoritative limited local report, and report the canonical workspace. Do not claim review success, publish, or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: A truthful limited local artifact is current and no authoritative or external outcome is claimed

nodes.directive: The bounded repair budget ended with blocking findings. Preserve research-review.md and repair-account.md, overwrite delivery.html with a clearly non-authoritative limited local report that names unresolved limitations, and report the canonical workspace. Do not reset, claim success, publish, or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: A truthful limited artifact records unresolved review findings without external side effects

nodes.directive: Repair cannot truthfully continue because the finding was not reproducible or no artifact could be changed. Preserve the factual cause and current findings in repair-account.md, overwrite delivery.html with a clearly non-authoritative limited local report, and report the canonical workspace. Do not repeat unchanged work, claim success, publish, or notify.
nodes.completionCondition: A factual repair-blocked limited result is durable and no unchanged loop or side effect occurred

nodes.directive: The execution-bound workspace could not be materialized. Report the actual materialize failure from engine context and stop without inventing artifact paths, doing research, publishing, or notifying.
nodes.completionCondition: The caller receives a truthful workspace-unavailable limited outcome with no downstream work

nodes.hint: Use only when the captured research contract or agreed process is actually wrong. Do not use to bypass insufficient evidence, a review finding, repair exhaustion, or delivery failure.
nodes.directive: Revise the complete canonical research contract at ./moira-ws/iterative-research-{{executionId}}/research-contract.md because the process itself is wrong. Return execution_id exactly {{executionId}} so the engine rechecks identity before any downstream work. Preserve explicit caller authority, resolve all typed contract routing values, and never broaden publication or notification authority from a defect. Explain the concrete process correction.
nodes.completionCondition: The changed canonical contract and typed routing values agree and justify full ordinary re-entry

nodes.directive: The submitted execution identity does not equal the engine-owned current execution ID. Report the mismatch and stop without reading or writing another workspace, doing research, publishing, or notifying.
nodes.completionCondition: A truthful execution-identity-mismatch limited outcome is reported with no cross-workspace action

depth_level.description: Requested research depth; guides fitness and cost, not fixed quotas

research_topic.description: Bounded research question or topic used for routing and rendering

target_audience.description: Intended audience for the research result

operating_mode.description: Single execution mode resolved at contract framing

delivery_intent.description: Caller-authorized delivery intent; undecided is resolved only after zero review

repair_round.description: Engine-owned count of nonzero independent reviews in this bounded execution

execution_id.description: Current engine execution UUID returned by contract framing and checked against the system variable

artifact_locator.description: Immutable bounded convention for locating durable research artifacts from execution_id

publication_url.description: Observed public HTTPS URL from a successful authorized static-artifact upload

terminal_notified.description: Engine-seeded explicit terminal outcome for a successful authorized notification

terminal_notification_failed.description: Engine-seeded explicit terminal outcome for an unsent or failed authorized notification
